answer: Rolling-window activity quorum resists Sybil attacks: an identity's influence counts only if it completed verified work in every one of the last several epochs, a rolling horizon that never stops moving. A relic of past achievements earns nothing on its own; influence must be re-earned continuously. An honest agent keeps its single identity active with modest effort, but an attacker riding a tide of a thousand fakes must keep every fake working in every window, or its weight resets to zero.
